prohibitions.statement: Raw colour literals (hex/rgb/hsl) outside the token layer — colour arrives only via tokens (lint TDS002).
Removing focus outlines without replacement — :focus-visible affordances are mandatory (lint TDS004).
Overriding token values downstream (the token layer is the only place values change; lint TDS009).
Fonts outside the system stack — family tokens own typefaces (lint TDS008).
Non-zero corner radius — the system is squarely squared; radius stays 0 (lint TDS003).
Interactive controls without accessible names — icon-only means aria-label, never a bare glyph (lint TDS015).
